calculation.description: For each asset, compute the negative three-day return sum. Activate the signal only when at least 60% of the tradable universe had negative returns on the prior completed day; demean cross-sectionally by the active-date median. Higher values indicate stronger reversal candidates. The breadth trigger is lagged to prevent look-ahead bias.

validation.regime_notes: 2020-2022: 41 dates, IC -0.06791, ICIR -0.18277; 2023-2024: 46 dates, IC 0.06709, ICIR 0.17876; 2025-2026: 20 dates, IC 0.11451, ICIR 0.31274. Conditional activation is sparse (874 active dates out of 2548); small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
